name: Balancing Work And Family
overview: Scripture teaches that balancing work and family requires trusting God's provision rather than exhausting oneself in relentless labor, as Psalms 127:2 reminds us that God grants rest to His beloved. Proverbs 23:4 warns against striving solely for wealth through human wisdom, encouraging a focus beyond material gain. Ecclesiastes 3:1 highlights that there is a divinely appointed time for every activity, underscoring the importance of discerning seasons in life. Acts 17:11 exemplifies the noble diligence of those who attentively study God's Word daily, suggesting that spiritual priorities must guide how we allocate our time between work and family.
